_comment: Default training configuration for the YOLOv11 wind comfort segmentation pipeline.
_comment_cls_pw: cls_pw = class weights power for handling class imbalance. 0.0 = disabled (uniform weights). 1.0 = full inverse-frequency weighting, automatically computed from the dataset. NEN_C and Uncomfortable are chronically under-predicted; setting cls_pw=1.0 makes Ultralytics upweight them automatically based on how rare they are.
_comment_cls: cls = overall classification loss weight relative to box/mask losses. Default Ultralytics value is 0.5. Raising to 1.0 doubles the classification signal.
name: wind_comfort_seg
